items.q: What flipped DHH from curiosity to 100% joy?
items.a: Not autocomplete. **Agents.** He dates it to **Nov 24, 2025** (Opus 4.5): output close enough to his Ruby that he stopped treating them as toys. Proof: **Omarchy Quattro** — ~3 months of agents, **zero hand-written shipped code** recently, **1,000+** merged PRs, live install **<60s**.

items.q: Where do the 10×–1000× gains actually appear?
items.a: Only when a human with **taste talks to agents directly**. PM/design/VP approval layers eat the surplus. Greenfield (Omarchy, Omawrite ~20 min) works; a Basecamp designer vibe sprint **destroyed architecture** and had to be mopped by hand.

items.q: How can experienced programmers get worse agent results?
items.a: The **overspecification trap**: prescribe **how** instead of **what**. Phases: instruct paths → steer → **state the problem**. Durable skill is **comparative taste** — pick among ~3 options — plus product sense.

items.q: Why does Linux win this era?
items.a: Everything is **files and CLIs**. Mac/Windows GUI lock-in is a caveman-click tax. Treat inbound agent PRs as **abundance**, not a curse. Vibe coding = ship **without reviewing**; programming = keep primitive understanding.
